YOUR LOCAL SPOT ON ANNAPOLIS ROAD

A small place
for big cravings.

We’re Taqueria Cinco de Mayo, a Latino-owned Mexican restaurant on Annapolis Road in Hyattsville, Maryland, near New Carrollton and Landover Hills. Our menu brings together Mexican favorites—from asada and al pastor tacos to mole poblano, enchiladas, and comforting caldos.

There’s plenty to discover beyond your usual order, too. Try a quesadilla with flor de calabaza or huitlacoche, explore our pupusas, or pair your meal with an agua fresca.

Stay for a meal or take your favorites to go. However you join us, you’re welcome here.
